name: Taletrot
summary:
Taletrot is a 3D adventure game for young children based on familiar fairy tales. Players help Cinderella prepare for the ball, build houses with the Three Little Pigs, and complete activities involving sorting, dressing up, cooking, counting, and simple puzzles. Picture-based controls and touch gestures guide play without requiring reading.

The game contains eight stories divided into 34 chapters. A separate listening mode combines recorded narration with animated 3D scenes. Cinderella and the Three Little Pigs are fully accessible for free; the other stories offer a free first playable chapter, with further chapters and full-story listening unlocked through in-app purchases.
